request.initial_prompt: _Fal._ Well, be gone: I will not miss her.

raw_segments.text: Shall, bodikins, master page, Though I now be old, forty and of the peace,
If I see a sword out, my finger itches to make one.
Though we are justices and doctors and churchmen, master page,
We have some salt of our youth in us.
We are the sons of women, master page.
